name: Mupixa
description_en:
Mupixa turns design images or imported prototypes into interactive experiences and collects interaction analytics, survey responses and replay data.

Its Storyboard model suits early-flow exploration, while report allowances, external recruitment and older contract wording need checking before commercial adoption.
description_zh:
Mupixa 将设计图片或导入原型组织成交互体验，并收集交互分析、问卷回答和回放数据。

其 Storyboard 模型适合早期流程探索；商业采用前需核对报告额度、外部招募以及较旧合同措辞。

core_features.name_zh: 由页面和热点组成的 Storyboard
core_features.explanation_en: Getting Started defines a Storyboard as a project, a page as an experience state and a hotspot as its active area; tags segment interactions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 入门文档将项目称为 Storyboard，页面代表体验状态，热点代表可交互区域，标签用于交互分组。

core_features.explanation_en: Pricing includes statistics/heatmaps on Free and lists session replay and interaction flow on Pro.
core_features.explanation_zh: 价格页将统计/热图列入 Free，Pro 增加会话回放和交互流。

core_features.explanation_en: The recruitment guide says Mupixa does not provide its own recruitment service and describes external completion IDs.
core_features.explanation_zh: 招募指南说 Mupixa 不提供自己的招募服务，并描述外部服务完成识别码。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_zh: 让预期交互可以被观察
sections.en:
Mupixa’s Getting Started documentation defines a project as a Storyboard, containing pages and hotspots; tags segment interactions. The public homepage describes importing designs and interactions through Figma, Adobe XD or Sketch plugins, or uploading images and making them interactive. Those are documented integration routes, not verified compatibility with current design-tool versions.

For a hypothetical navigation concept, create the relevant page states, connect hotspots and define a task that does not reveal the intended label. Share the experience and compare the actual paths with the intended route. Keep a record of the tested version: a missing hotspot or an artificial end state can produce apparent failure that belongs to the prototype rather than the underlying product idea. No import, hotspot editor or participant run was tested here.
sections.zh:
Mupixa 入门文档将项目定义为 Storyboard，内部包含页面和热点，标签用于交互分组。公开首页描述通过 Figma、Adobe XD、Sketch 插件导入设计及交互，或上传图片后添加交互。这些是文档集成路径，未验证其与设计工具当前版本的兼容性。

以导航概念为假设，可建立相关页面状态、连接热点，再定义不直接暴露目标标签的任务。分享体验后比较真实路径与预期路线。应记录测试版本：缺少热点或人为终止状态可能制造失败，这属于原型问题，未必是产品概念问题。本研究未测试导入、热点编辑器或参与者会话。

sections.title_en: A heatmap needs a task and a denominator
sections.title_zh: 热图需要任务背景和样本分母
sections.en:
The site lists statistics, heatmaps, session replays, interaction flow, answers and comments, with dynamic surveys and A/B testing among paid features. Use these views together: a hotspot concentration shows where recorded interactions happened, while a replay and answer may help explain an individual attempt. Counts alone do not establish a user’s motivation or causally predict conversion.

Emotion Evaluation and eye tracking also appear in the feature/plan material, with eye tracking listed under Enterprise. Their sensing method, device requirements and validity were not established. Do not interpret an emotion label as a reliable psychological state or assume that ordinary browser access gives calibrated gaze measurements. The current sample definition, export schema, recording coverage and missing-event handling require a real pilot.
sections.zh:
网站列出统计、热图、会话回放、交互流、回答和评论，付费功能还包括动态问卷及 A/B 测试。应结合这些视图：热点集中显示已记录交互发生在哪里，回放和回答可帮助解释个别尝试。单看计数不能建立用户动机，也不能因果预测转化。

功能及套餐材料还出现 Emotion Evaluation 和眼动追踪，眼动追踪列在 Enterprise。其采集方法、设备要求和有效性尚未建立，不能将情绪标签视为可靠心理状态，也不能假定普通浏览器访问就有校准后的注视测量。当前样本定义、导出结构、录制覆盖和缺失事件处理仍需真实试点核对。

sections.title_en: Free reports and paid replays are different allowances
sections.title_zh: 免费报告和付费回放是不同权益
sections.en:
The actual browser pricing view lists Free with three projects and 20 reports, including statistics, heatmaps, context notifications, responses and comments. It positions Free for personal use. Pro adds unlimited projects/reports, session replay, interaction flow, dynamic surveys, branding and other experience features. The selected USD annual view visibly showed 12 per month for Pro; the annual invoice total and renewal checkout were not captured. Enterprise is custom and lists live sessions, eye tracking, network access restrictions and priority support.

The price page says Pro renews automatically and an already-started cycle is not refundable. Its monthly/annual selector differs from the older terms, last updated 01.04.2020, which describe a 12-month term and termination one month before term end. Preserve this discrepancy: confirm the actual order’s duration and cancellation deadline rather than assuming the monthly price is a month-to-month commitment.
sections.zh:
实际浏览器价格状态列出 Free 三个项目、20 份报告，包含统计、热图、上下文通知、回答和评论，并将 Free 定位为个人使用。Pro 增加无限项目/报告、会话回放、交互流、动态问卷、品牌定制及其他体验功能。选中的美元年付状态视觉上显示 Pro 折合每月 12；未捕获年付发票总额或续费结账。Enterprise 定制，列出实时会话、眼动追踪、网络访问限制和优先支持。

价格页说 Pro 自动续费，已开始周期不可退款。其月付/年付选择与更新于 01.04.2020 的旧条款有差异，后者写 12 个月期限及期末前一个月终止。应保留这一差异，确认实际订单期限和取消截止时间，不能用月均价推定逐月承诺。

sections.title_en: Bring participants and verify completion separately
sections.title_zh: 自带参与者并单独确认完成
sections.en:
The recruitment guide explicitly says Mupixa does not currently offer participant recruitment. It describes using an external service such as Mechanical Turk, with a generated unique ID on an End Page to confirm completion before paying the external cost. That documentation is marked last updated two years ago; present-day integration behavior was not tested.

Define who qualifies, how the invitation is distributed and how consent and compensation are handled before sharing the prototype. A completion identifier is a workflow link between tools, not evidence that a participant understood the task or supplied valid feedback. External recruitment fees, incidence, returns and quality rules remain separate from a Mupixa subscription.
sections.zh:
招募指南明确说 Mupixa 当前不提供参与者招募。它描述使用 Mechanical Turk 等外部服务，并通过 End Page 生成的唯一 ID 确认完成，再支付外部费用。文档标注最后更新于两年前，当前集成行为未实测。

分享原型前，应定义资格、邀请分发方式、同意和报酬处理。完成识别码只是工具间的流程连接，不证明参与者理解任务或提供有效反馈。外部招募费、符合条件比例、退回和质量规则均与 Mupixa 订阅分开。

sections.title_en: Check the data path behind the analytics
sections.title_zh: 核对分析背后的数据路径
sections.en:
The reviewed terms identify Mupixa as proprietary SaaS, reserve the platform’s rights and allow technical/support information plus automatic internal processing of assets and analytics to improve or add features. They also require test users to agree to collection terms. The privacy page, also labeled 01.04.2020, describes infrastructure/service subprocessors and pseudonymized usage evaluation for experience and advertising. A declaration of anonymous test-user access is therefore not a blanket statement that no device or behavioral data is collected.

Before confidential research, inspect the applicable DPA, current subprocessors, participant notice, export/retention controls and permissions on the exact experience. No claim of local-only processing, calibrated emotion analysis, current legal completeness or deletion success is made. Mupixa is a documentation-based candidate for exploring interactive concepts; the dated policy and billing mismatch remain procurement questions.
sections.zh:
已读条款将 Mupixa 描述为专有 SaaS，保留平台权利，并允许使用技术/支持信息，以及自动内部处理素材和分析数据来改进或增加功能，也要求测试用户同意收集条款。同样标注 01.04.2020 的隐私页描述基础设施/服务分处理方，以及为体验和广告进行的假名化用量评估。因此，测试用户可匿名访问的描述，不等于不收集任何设备或行为数据。

保密研究前，应检查适用 DPA、当前分处理方、参与者说明、导出/保留控制和具体体验权限。本稿不保证仅本地处理、情绪测量校准、现行法律文件完整或删除成功。文档显示 Mupixa 可作为交互概念探索的候选，较旧政策及计费差异仍需在采购时解决。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: Confirm current billing term, report scope, plugin compatibility and current participant/data processing terms.
research_gaps.zh: 需确认当前账期、报告额度范围、插件兼容性及参与者/数据处理条款。

research_gaps.en: Emotion/eye-tracking method and validity, event coverage, exports and real participant behavior were not tested.
research_gaps.zh: 情绪/眼动方法及有效性、事件覆盖、导出和真实参与者行为均未测试。
